entities.summary: Catholic Church, a political institution in Chile during Independence and the O'Higgins Republic (1830–1861). Grew from Formal independence declared — February 12, 1818 and Battle of Chacabuco — O'Higgins and San Martín liberate Chile, February 12, 1817. Led to the emergence of Peru-Bolivia Confederation.
